name: Human Ghost Bard (CR 1)

HUMAN GHOST BARD
CR 1

Human bard 1/trickster 1
N humanoid (human)

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 13, flat-footed 12 (+2 armor, +3 Dex)

Gear bard’s kit (41 gp), leather armor (10 gp), mask (50 gp), sunrod (2 gp), whip (1 gp), 1 gp
